title: Hence most Roman doctors grant it was natural in the sense of native, not acquired
source_text: XLIII. Proindeque quod illinc manifeste sequitur, plerique Doctores Ecclesiae Romanae cum Protestantibus agnoscunt justitiam Originalem primo homini naturalem fuisse, quatenus naturale significat idem quod nativum, & opponitur ei quod est adventitium & superadditum.
pass_a_gloss: And therefore what manifestly follows thence, most Doctors of the Roman Church acknowledge with the Protestants that Original justice was natural to the first man, insofar as natural signifies the same as native, and is opposed to that which is adventitious and superadded.
pass_b_english: It plainly follows that most teachers of the Roman Church grant, with the Protestants, that original righteousness was natural to the first man in the sense in which "natural" means the same as "native" and is opposed to what is acquired and added on top.

choices.why: Le Blanc equates the two terms; quotation marks show they are words being compared.
